faq.question: Is this course suitable for beginners?
faq.answer: Yes! The program is structured from beginner foundations to professional-level implementation. Module 1 establishes core LLM concepts without jargon, and Module 3 introduces Python specifically tailored for AI builders step-by-step. While prior tech interest helps, no computer science degree or advanced coding background is required.

faq.question: Do I need prior coding experience?
faq.answer: No prior software development experience is required. We teach you the exact Python needed to build, connect, and debug AI applications (functions, data structures, APIs, JSON, and environment variables). If you prefer a minimal-code career, Track A (AI Automation Specialist) focuses on n8n, webhooks, and visual workflow builders.

faq.question: How much Python will I learn?
faq.answer: You will learn practical, modern Python specifically for AI solution engineering: calling LLM APIs, handling structured JSON, parsing files, interacting with vector databases (pgvector/Supabase), creating REST endpoints with FastAPI, and handling environment secrets. We skip irrelevant academic theory to focus purely on building functional AI systems.

faq.question: What is Agentic AI?
faq.answer: Agentic AI refers to autonomous systems that don't just generate text, but actively reason, plan, choose tools, and execute multi-step tasks to achieve a goal. In this course, you advance from simple tool calling to building stateful multi-agent workflows using LangGraph and the OpenAI Agents SDK where agents collaborate to solve complex problems.

faq.question: What is RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)?
faq.answer: RAG connects LLMs to your private business documents and databases so the model provides accurate, up-to-date answers with verifiable citations without retraining. You will master document chunking, embeddings, vector indexing with pgvector/Supabase, semantic search, and hallucination reduction guardrails.

faq.question: What is Model Context Protocol (MCP)?
faq.answer: Model Context Protocol (MCP) is an open industry standard introduced by Anthropic that standardizes how AI applications connect to external tools, databases, and enterprise software. In Module 8, you will build connected AI systems that utilize MCP servers and clients to interact safely with external business tools.

faq.question: Will I learn n8n for enterprise automation?
faq.answer: Yes! n8n is our primary enterprise automation engine in Module 6. You will build production-grade workflows triggered by webhooks, integrating Google Workspace, CRMs (like HubSpot), databases, and LLM nodes with error retries, logging, and human-in-the-loop approval steps.

faq.question: Will I build real AI agents and deploy them?
faq.answer: Absolutely. You will build multiple real-world agents including a multi-agent business research team, an automated lead qualification system, and an intelligent customer support agent. Every major project is packaged and deployed with live public URLs—not just run on your local computer.

faq.question: What portfolio projects will I build?
faq.answer: You will build 6 core portfolio projects and 1 industry capstone: (1) AI Research & Report Agent, (2) Enterprise RAG Knowledge Assistant, (3) AI Lead Qualification & CRM Automation, (4) AI Customer Support Agent, (5) AI Data Analyst, (6) Production Full-Stack AI Microservice, and (7) An end-to-end AI Operations System for a real business.

faq.question: Can non-technical students join this program?
faq.answer: Yes. Non-technical students and business professionals thrive in this course, especially on Track A (AI Automation Specialist), which leverages n8n, webhooks, and visual logic. For those wanting deeper engineering skills, our progressive curriculum supports you from first principles into Python development.

faq.question: What is the difference between AI Automation Specialist and AI Solutions Engineer?
faq.answer: AI Automation Specialists focus on no-code/low-code workflow orchestration, connecting enterprise software, CRMs, and LLMs using platforms like n8n and Make. AI Solutions Engineers build custom software, writing Python, designing vector databases, building custom agent loops in LangGraph, and deploying containerized FastAPI backends. Both paths share common foundations in this unified program.

faq.question: Will I receive a portfolio upon graduation?
faq.answer: Yes. You will graduate with a verified public GitHub portfolio containing clean code repositories, architectural diagrams, video demonstrations, live cloud deployment URLs, and systematic evaluation reports that give hiring managers and clients tangible proof of work.

faq.question: Which AI models and toolchains are covered?
faq.answer: You will work with OpenAI (GPT-4o), Anthropic (Claude 3.5 Sonnet), Google (Gemini 1.5 Pro), open-source local models via Ollama (Llama 3), Python, n8n, LangGraph, Supabase, pgvector, Cursor, Docker, and modern cloud deployment platforms.

faq.question: What happens if AI tools change during the course?
faq.answer: Nova Skills teaches underlying architectural principles—context windows, embeddings, vector mathematics, state machines, API protocols, and evaluation—rather than fleeting tool interfaces. When a new model or tool releases, you will know how to plug it in seamlessly within hours.

faq.question: What is the fee and are there EMI options?
faq.answer: The official tuition is ₹39,999 (all-inclusive with 18% GST). We provide 0% interest No-Cost EMI options starting at approximately ₹3,999/month across flexible bank and NBFC tenures. Live interactive mentoring, 12+ labs, portfolio reviews, and dedicated placement support are fully included.
